summary: Frontend-only test of Paxity same-tab payment flow with PaymentReturnRedirect. Seeded orders/paxity_transactions for tx_qa_tab_1, exercised /commande pending screen, clicked paxity-payment-link-btn, verified same-tab navigation, simulated Paxity redirect back to root, sent SUCCESS webhook and asserted confirmation screen + localStorage cleanup, and verified no redirect loop after confirmation. All 4 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentReturnRedirect (App.js) fires on every full page load whenever sec_pending_paxity_tx_v1 exists and the path is not in the exclusion list (/commande, /vendeur, /admin, /paiement). In production this is fine because Paxity's payment_link is an external URL and the browser navigates away completely, but any same-origin URL used as payment_link (e.g. the test /mentions simulation) will boomerang instantly to /commande, which prevented the literal 'page.url becomes /mentions' assertion. If Paxity payment_link ever resolves to a same-origin URL (proxy, iframe fallback, or internal hosted-checkout), the current logic will bounce the customer off the payment page. Consider (a) also excluding the payment_link path/hostname before redirecting, or (b) only redirecting when the current path is the app root or a whitelisted return path.
seed_data_creation: Inserted orders.qa_tab_1 and paxity_transactions.tx_qa_tab_1 in MongoDB (db from backend/.env), then deleted both after tests via /app/scripts/seed_qa_tab.py cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test results: TEST1 same-tab OK (context.pages stayed at 1 after click); URL didn't literally become /mentions because PaymentReturnRedirect immediately redirected the same-origin /mentions load to /commande — expected given current exclusion list. TEST2 auto-redirect from root to /commande OK. TEST3 webhook (POST /api/paxity/webhook via curl) triggers confirmation screen (order-confirmed-title data-testid visible) and clears sec_pending_paxity_tx_v1 within ~4s of the 2s polling. TEST4 after cleanup, navigating to / stays on /. Note: urllib.request gets 403 from the ingress (bot filter); use curl or the requests library. Webhook body shape expected: {"data":{"transactionId":..., "status":"SUCCESS"}}.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. The only nuance is a behavioural quirk documented in critical_code_review_comments — PaymentReturnRedirect does not whitelist /mentions, so a same-origin payment_link is bounced back to /commande on load. Same-tab navigation itself (window.location.href) works correctly and no new browser tab/window is opened. Confirmation flow via 2s polling + webhook works end-to-end.
